name: Brandulf
title: Keeper of the Horn and Hearth
examine: Loud on purpose. A quiet inn past the treeline is a cold thought, so there are no quiet nights under his roof, and no secrets either, try as you might.
lines: Fire never dies here. House law.
Broth, bed, and the whole town's business by the second mug.
The buyer is in the good room. Being polite at him is the town sport.
